FIELD NOTES

Good questions.

Can I download DataMapper Pro?+

Not yet. We’re getting it ready for release. Download links and purchasing details will appear here when they’re available.

Is this the actual extension?+

The interactive demo is a website concept using three sample records. It illustrates the mapping workflow; it is not the DataMapper Pro extension interface.

Who is it for?+

Administrators, consultants, operations teams, and anyone who spends too much time preparing files to move between systems.

Practical tools. Wild possibilities.
